canonicalIngredients.name: peanut butter
observations: none - 3/4 cup pounded roasted peanuts instead (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: rice
observations: steamed rice to serve (s0); s1 serves with lime wedges, s2 with roti

causalSequence: mix marinade: coconut milk, soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, lime juice, spices
slice chicken into strips or cubes; coat in marinade; refrigerate 2 h to overnight
soak bamboo skewers 30 min; thread chicken 4-5 pieces per skewer
grill or pan-fry skewers 3-5 min per side to 75 C internal
simmer sauce: coconut milk, peanut butter, brown sugar, soy and fish sauce; 5 min until thick; loosen with water; finish with lime
steam rice; plate skewers on rice; pour over sauce; top with peanuts, coriander, lime wedges
techniqueFacts: all three marinate at least 1-2 h, overnight preferred for juiciness
internal temperature target 75 C / 165 F (two sources)
two sources thread 4-5 pieces per skewer; one threads a single long strip per skewer
two sources soak bamboo skewers in water ~30 min before grilling
natural unsweetened peanut butter called out as the sauce lever (s0); s2 pounds whole roasted peanuts instead for chunkier sauce
sauce simmered ~5 min to thicken in two sources; s1 only whisks with boiling water, no cooking
turmeric supplies the signature yellow colour (two sources)
cook on grill, grill pan, non-stick pan, or under broiler; ~3-5 min per side in all three
servings note: s0 card says serves 3 but author note says ~30 skewers serving 6; s1 states yield only (10-12 skewers)
